norm.subsidy_budget_note: Resolução CGSR 111/2026 (art. 2) sets R$ 1,000,000.00 for soybean in the ZarcNM pilot for 2026, shared by Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul and Mato Grosso do Sul (states as reported by Agrolink, 7 Aug 2026). The rate applies only while that budget lasts, and only to fields classified by Embrapa's method; payment depends on federal funds.
norm.subsidy_brl_per_ha_note: null: no published average soybean premium per hectare for Rio Grande do Sul was found. The PSR 2024 report (Atlas do Seguro Rural) gives only the national soybean figures (R$ 2,007 million of premium on 4.83 million ha, about R$ 415/ha in 2024) and RS totals for all crops; neither is a Rio Grande do Sul soybean premium, so no R$/ha is estimated.
norm.subsidy_source_note: Percentages and budget read on the Legismap transcription of the resolution (DOU 29/04/2026); the DOU PDF was not opened.

paths.label: Soybean - wheat
paths.summary: pre-check: 3 of 6 indicators observable; NM range 2-3 if soil tests are at level 4; contour to confirm

indicators.name: Base saturation (V%) in the 0-20 cm layer
indicators.name_pt: Saturação por bases (V%) na camada 0 a 20 cm
indicators.basis: not observable from satellite: needs soil test (georeferenced samples, accredited lab; IN 2/2025 items 4.1-III and 7).

indicators.name: Calcium (Ca, cmolc/dm3) in the 20-40 cm layer
indicators.name_pt: Teor de cálcio (Ca) na camada 20 a 40 cm
indicators.basis: not observable from satellite: needs soil test (georeferenced samples, accredited lab; IN 2/2025 items 4.1-III and 7).

indicators.name: Aluminium saturation (m%) in the 20-40 cm layer
indicators.name_pt: Saturação por alumínio (m%) na camada 20 a 40 cm
indicators.basis: not observable from satellite: needs soil test (georeferenced samples, accredited lab; IN 2/2025 items 4.1-III and 7).

indicators.name: Time (T) without soil tillage, complete years
indicators.basis: Assumed continuous no-till for at least 8 complete years (level 4), the same for the three paths. Not measured: the norm dates the last tillage from sudden changes in the satellite time series (item 6.8); a Landsat time-series check is still pending and could confirm or lower this. 5-7 years gives level 3, 3-4 years level 2, under 3 years level 1.

indicators.name: Soil cover (C) with straw before sowing the main crop, %
indicators.name_pt: Cobertura do solo (C) com palhada em pré-semeadura da cultura principal (%)
indicators.basis: Straw on 1, 16 and 30 November from the straw clock: 2.22-4.12 t/ha (arithmetic from measured half-lives, not a field measurement). Converted to cover with Gregory (1982), cover = 1 - exp(-Am x kg/ha), Am (mass-to-cover coefficient: hectares of ground covered per kg of straw) 0.00024-0.00054 ha/kg (wheat stems only to complete wheat residue; no Am for black oat was found, wheat values used): 41-89% cover. The norm measures C with NDTI in the month before sowing (IN 2/2025 item 6.7); no NDTI threshold was calibrated here.

indicators.name: Diversity (D) of crops in rotation in the last 3 agricultural years
indicators.name_pt: Diversidade (D) de cultivos nos últimos três anos agrícolas
indicators.basis: 6 crops (3 soybean + 3 wheat), 2 species, 2 families: level 2. No cover crop, so level 3 is not met; wheat as the main winter crop is not a 3rd crop or autumn-window grass (item 2.4-I). Counted: 6 crops, 2 species, 2 families.

nm_range.condition: if all 3 soil-test indicators (V%, Ca, m%) are at level 4, contour sowing is confirmed (or slope < 3%), the soil is deeper than 1 m, and no-till holds for 8+ years

locks.rule: slope >= 3% requires contour sowing on at least 75% of the area in the last year, else NM1
locks.note: Assumed compliant in the level range. The slope comes from NASADEM (item 6.3); contour sowing is not checked here.

locks.rule: two or more consecutive soybean crops (soja sobre soja) -> NM1
locks.note: A winter crop sits between the soybean crops.

locks.rule: legume-only crop before or after soybean, without other species -> at most NM2
locks.note: The winter crop includes a grass (wheat, or black oat in the oat + vetch consortium).

locks.rule: two or more indicators at level 1 -> NM1; two at level 2, or one at 1 and one at 2 -> NM2
locks.note: Included in the level range for every combination of the ranges above.

locks.rule: mean at level 3-4 with m% at level 1 -> NM2; with m% at level 2 -> NM3
locks.note: m% is a soil-test indicator; the by-soil-level table shows its effect.

locks.rule: the class is limited to the NM whose root depth (40/60/80/100 cm) is below the useful soil depth Zus; Zus < 50 cm stays at NM1
locks.note: Assumed deep soil in the level range; needs a soil profile, not visible from satellite.

notes: pre-check: 3 of 6 indicators observable; NM range 2-3 if soil tests are at level 4; contour to confirm
At the low end of the straw-cover range (C level 2) C and D are both at level 2, which caps the class at NM2 (item 3.2.1-IV-b); at C level 3 the mean is exactly 3.50, still NM3.

paths.summary: pre-check: 3 of 6 indicators observable; NM range 1-2 if soil tests are at level 4; contour to confirm

indicators.name: Base saturation (V%) in the 0-20 cm layer
indicators.name_pt: Saturação por bases (V%) na camada 0 a 20 cm
indicators.basis: not observable from satellite: needs soil test (georeferenced samples, accredited lab; IN 2/2025 items 4.1-III and 7).

indicators.name: Calcium (Ca, cmolc/dm3) in the 20-40 cm layer
indicators.name_pt: Teor de cálcio (Ca) na camada 20 a 40 cm
indicators.basis: not observable from satellite: needs soil test (georeferenced samples, accredited lab; IN 2/2025 items 4.1-III and 7).

indicators.name: Aluminium saturation (m%) in the 20-40 cm layer
indicators.name_pt: Saturação por alumínio (m%) na camada 20 a 40 cm
indicators.basis: not observable from satellite: needs soil test (georeferenced samples, accredited lab; IN 2/2025 items 4.1-III and 7).

indicators.name: Time (T) without soil tillage, complete years
indicators.basis: Assumed continuous no-till for at least 8 complete years (level 4), the same for the three paths. Not measured: the norm dates the last tillage from sudden changes in the satellite time series (item 6.8); a Landsat time-series check is still pending and could confirm or lower this. 5-7 years gives level 3, 3-4 years level 2, under 3 years level 1.

indicators.name: Soil cover (C) with straw before sowing the main crop, %
indicators.name_pt: Cobertura do solo (C) com palhada em pré-semeadura da cultura principal (%)
indicators.basis: No winter straw in the straw clock (no winter crop). Level 1 (C < 30%) if the fallow is kept clean; level 2 cannot be excluded because the April soybean residue and winter weeds or volunteers are not modelled (the Cruz Alta trial gives no soybean half-life).

indicators.name: Diversity (D) of crops in rotation in the last 3 agricultural years
indicators.name_pt: Diversidade (D) de cultivos nos últimos três anos agrícolas
indicators.basis: 3 crops (soybean only), 1 species, 1 family: fewer than the 4 crops of level 2, so level 1. Counted: 3 crops, 1 species, 1 families.

nm_range.condition: if all 3 soil-test indicators (V%, Ca, m%) are at level 4, contour sowing is confirmed (or slope < 3%), the soil is deeper than 1 m, and no-till holds for 8+ years

locks.rule: slope >= 3% requires contour sowing on at least 75% of the area in the last year, else NM1
locks.note: Assumed compliant in the level range. The slope comes from NASADEM (item 6.3); contour sowing is not checked here.

locks.rule: two or more consecutive soybean crops (soja sobre soja) -> NM1
locks.note: Soybean every summer with nothing in winter: read literally, the soybean crops are consecutive. The norm does not say whether a fallow winter breaks the sequence; the level range keeps both readings.

locks.rule: legume-only crop before or after soybean, without other species -> at most NM2
locks.note: The crop before and after each soybean is soybean, a legume.

locks.rule: two or more indicators at level 1 -> NM1; two at level 2, or one at 1 and one at 2 -> NM2
locks.note: Included in the level range for every combination of the ranges above.

locks.rule: mean at level 3-4 with m% at level 1 -> NM2; with m% at level 2 -> NM3
locks.note: m% is a soil-test indicator; the by-soil-level table shows its effect.

locks.rule: the class is limited to the NM whose root depth (40/60/80/100 cm) is below the useful soil depth Zus; Zus < 50 cm stays at NM1
locks.note: Assumed deep soil in the level range; needs a soil profile, not visible from satellite.

notes: pre-check: 3 of 6 indicators observable; NM range 1-2 if soil tests are at level 4; contour to confirm
D is at level 1 whatever the straw: one more indicator at level 1 gives NM1 (item 3.2.1-IV-a). Without the soy-on-soy reading the best case is NM2.

caveats: Pre-check, not a certificate: the official class is produced only by Embrapa's SINM after the three data subsets are registered by accredited agents (IN 2/2025, items 4.1-4.6).

3 of the 6 indicators (V%, Ca, m%) need a soil test (0-20 and 20-40 cm, accredited lab, valid 24 months, item 7.8); they are not observable from satellite. The by-soil-level table gives the NM range with all three soil-test indicators at the same level n (1-4); mixed soil levels are not tabulated.
Contour sowing on slopes >= 3% (item 3.2.1-I) and the useful soil depth (Portaria 209/2026 item 2.4) are assumed compliant; either can force NM1.

Straw cover is arithmetic: straw clock (one trial's half-lives, scenario windows) converted with Gregory's mass-to-cover relation using wheat coefficients from US measurements. No NDTI threshold was calibrated against field cover.
T (years without tillage) is an assumption (8+ years of no-till) until the Landsat series is checked.
The ZarcNM subsidy for soybean has a budget of R$ 1 million in 2026 for four states (Resolução CGSR 111/2026).
Portaria 209/2026 item 2.1 speaks of 'sete indicadores'; IN 2/2025 Table 1, which this pre-check follows, lists six.

sources.label: Instrução Normativa SPA/MAPA nº 2, de 8 de julho de 2025, Annex (soybean), DOU 09/07/2025, ed. 127, seção 1, p. 3
Portaria SPA/MAPA nº 209, de 30 de junho de 2026 (ZarcNM soybean, Rio Grande do Sul, 2026/27), DOU 03/07/2026, seção 1
Resolução CGSR nº 111, de 28 de abril de 2026 (Legismap transcription)
Agrolink, 07/08/2026, 'Seguro rural em agosto: PSR reserva R$ 1 milhão para soja' (states of the pilot)
FieldShift straw clock (analysis/storms-bare-soil/results/straw_clock.json): half-lives from Campos et al. (2011), initial straw from Aita & Giacomini (2003) and Santos et al. (2019)
Santos et al. (ed.) (2019), Sistemas de produção para cereais de inverno: três décadas de estudos, Embrapa (winter species, oat + vetch consortium)

McCool, D.K.; Sharratt, B.S.; Krauss, H.A.; McClellan, R.C. (2006). Residue characteristics for wind and water erosion control. 14th ISCO Conference, Marrakech (quotes Gregory, J.M. 1982, Trans. ASAE 25:1333-1337, Am for wheat residue)
MAPA, Relatório Geral PSR 2024, Table 11 (national soybean premium and area)

slope.source: NASADEM (NASA JPL, 1 arc-second, SRTM-based, year-2000 surface) via the Microsoft Planetary Computer collection 'nasadem' (anonymous); reprojected bilinearly to UTM 22S at 30 m; slope = 100 x the magnitude of the elevation gradient (numpy.gradient, central differences)
slope.cropland_mask: ESA WorldCover 2021 class 40, >= 50% of the 30 m pixel, inside IBGE municipality 4306106
slope.norm_rule: IN SPA/MAPA 2/2025 item 3.2.1 I: slope >= 3% requires contour sowing (or sowing on the level) on at least 75% of the area in the last year, otherwise the management level is NM1. The norm defines no other slope class.
slope.context_classes_note: Relief classes used by Embrapa soil surveys (flat 0-3%, gently undulating 3-8%, undulating 8-20%, strongly undulating 20-45%); context only, not classes of the norm.
slope.warning: The satellite and the DEM do not see contour sowing, terraces or sowing on the level: they only say where the rule applies (slope >= 3%), not whether the field complies. NASADEM noise at 30 m inflates slope on gentle relief; a field's mean slope (item 6.3) can differ from the pixel shares here.

rule_locks: Slope ≥ 3% without contour planting on 75% of the area → NM1.
interpretations: "More than 4 months" = more than 121.75 days (4 average months).
The 6-crop minimum of level 3 applies to both sides of its "OU".
At level 4, the "2 covers of more than 45 days" are in addition to the cover of more than 4 months (3 covers in all).
When several locks apply, the most restrictive wins (item 3.2 only says they have priority over the mean).
"Consecutive soybean crops": the norm does not say whether a fallow winter breaks the sequence. Read literally, soybean-fallow-soybean is consecutive; the pre-check keeps both readings in the range.
An item 2.4-I grass counts as one cover of more than 45 days.
subsidy_brl_per_ha_note: null: no published average soybean premium per hectare for Rio Grande do Sul was found. The PSR 2024 report (Atlas do Seguro Rural) gives only the national soybean figures (R$ 2,007 million of premium on 4.83 million ha, about R$ 415/ha in 2024) and RS totals for all crops; neither is a Rio Grande do Sul soybean premium, so no R$/ha is estimated.

residue.attribution: NASA/USGS Landsat; NASA HLS; ESA WorldCover 2021 (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2021); IBGE municipal mesh 2022
caveats: No field calibration: 'probable bare soil' is a spectral inference with a threshold chosen by this analysis, not a measured residue cover.
NDTI is sensitive to soil and residue moisture (Quemada and Daughtry 2016) and to kaolinite-rich soils (Hively et al. 2021); the Oxisols of Cruz Alta are kaolinitic.
Different sensors (TM, ETM+, OLI, OLI-2, MSI) without a field-based cross-calibration of NDTI.
One cropland mask (WorldCover 2021) for 40 years: fields that changed use are misclassified.

alternate.label: Alternate wheat and cover
alternate.derived_how: Derived here with the functions of analysis/zarcnm-precheck (straw_indicator, level_diversity, level_years_without_tillage, nm_range): straw cover C is the union of the wheat and cover ranges, diversity D is computed for the 3-year sequences W-C-W and C-W-C with 93 and 199 days of cover, T assumed 8+ years as in the other paths, no soy-on-soy and no legume-only succession.

nm_range.condition: if all 3 soil-test indicators (V%, Ca, m%) are at level 4, contour sowing is confirmed (or slope < 3%), the soil is deeper than 1 m, and no-till holds for 8+ years
